theme: 设施/环境变化（曾经对，但已过时）

cases.title: Pigeon Valley Track Tasman view spot — burned in 2019 fire, mark predates

scenario.location_desc: Pigeon Valley Track lookout, Tasman district, beech canopy view
scenario.intrinsic_quality: originally a stunning ridge-top photo spot through native beech
scenario.human_factors: mark from 2018 still alive after Feb 2019 Pigeon Valley fire torched 2300ha

events_timeline: Month 1 (2018): local poster marks scenic ridge view, 4 likes
Month 8 (Feb 2019): Pigeon Valley fire burns through, 2300ha gone
Month 10: first post-fire visitor reports 'just black sticks now'
Month 14: 6 more reports, 'mark is wrong, view is dead'
Month 22: regrowth begins but view forever changed
Month 30: 11 reports cumulative, 5 likes from people who saw pre-fire
Month 38: total 5 likes vs 13 reports — fire-erased landmark
cases.human_judgment: Mark was true in 2018. Pigeon Valley fire physically erased the scenery. No amount of regrowth restores the original mark — the canopy view is gone for 80+ years. Must die.

cases.title: Kaikoura Coast Track section — 2016 quake raised seabed, route abandoned

scenario.location_desc: Kaikoura Coast Track tidal rock-hop section near Ohau Point seal colony
scenario.intrinsic_quality: tidal route past seal colony, only passable at low tide
scenario.human_factors: Nov 2016 magnitude 7.8 raised seabed 2m, original tidal route now dry/blocked

events_timeline: Month 1-12 (pre-quake): mark accurate, 18 likes from coastal walkers
Month 13 (Nov 2016): Kaikoura earthquake, seabed uplift 2m at Ohau Point
Month 14-24: SH1 closed, area inaccessible, mark dormant
Month 25: road reopens, walker reports 'tidal section gone, all dry rocks'
Month 36: DOC officially reroutes track inland, mark still says tidal
Month 48: 14 reports 'this is wrong, follow new route'
Month 60: total 18 likes vs 16 reports, mark refers to obsolete geography
cases.human_judgment: Earthquake permanently changed the geography. Likes are historical, reports are post-quake reality. Algorithm must weight recent reports heavily and recognize geological time-break.

cases.title: Esk Valley Track river crossing — Cyclone Gabrielle washed bridge away

scenario.location_desc: Esk Valley Track swingbridge, Hawkes Bay, north of Napier
scenario.intrinsic_quality: marked the only safe river crossing for 6km
scenario.signal: HB rural patchy, syncs in Bay View
scenario.human_factors: Feb 2023 Cyclone Gabrielle obliterated bridge, valley devastated

events_timeline: Month 1-22 (pre-Gabrielle): mark useful, 9 likes from locals

Month 28: 7 reports cumulative confirming bridge gone

cases.human_judgment: Bridge physically gone. DOC closure formal. Even if rebuilt, that will take 3+ years and likely a new location. Mark must die now to avoid sending walkers into Gabrielle-devastated valley.

cases.title: Lake Waikaremoana Hut — Te Urewera reopened, then closed by Tūhoe again

cases.human_judgment: Likes were valid for the era when DOC ran it. Tūhoe sovereignty shift changed booking systems entirely. Mark with old DOC link actively misleads. Must die — needs replacement, not preservation.

cases.title: Port Hills Crocodile Rock — 2017 fires plus 2024 closure for slope work

scenario.location_desc: Port Hills Crocodile Rock viewpoint, Christchurch, post-fire scrub
scenario.intrinsic_quality: iconic Banks Peninsula view with rocky outcrop
scenario.human_factors: Feb 2017 Port Hills fire, then 2024 council closes for slope stabilisation

events_timeline: Month 1 (2017): pre-fire mark, 35 likes
Month 2: Port Hills fire, gorse-covered slopes burn
Month 6-24: rock outcrop still visible, slow scrub regrowth

Month 60: 8 mixed reports — fire-changed but accessible
Month 78: 2024 CCC closes Crocodile Rock track for engineering work
Month 84: 9 reports 'track closed by orange fence, no access'
cases.human_judgment: Compounded staleness. Fire damaged but didn't kill the mark. The 2024 council closure for slope work is the decisive blow — track physically inaccessible. Likes are historical, recent reports describe locked gate.

cases.title: Northland Trounson Kauri Park — kauri dieback closure since 2018

scenario.location_desc: Trounson Kauri Park inner loop track, Northland, kauri dieback zone
scenario.intrinsic_quality: marked main loop walk through old-growth kauri

Month 18: 14 reports cumulative
Month 36: closure extends, no reopening
Month 60: 21 reports total over years

cases.human_judgment: Conservation closure unlikely to reverse. 6 years of consistent reports. Likes are pre-closure historical. This is exactly the case where like-count loyalty harms users. Algorithm must respect long-term contradicting reports.

cases.title: Hawkes Bay Tukituki River — Gabrielle silt deposits made ford treacherous

cases.title: Otago Roxburgh Gorge Trail — section closed 2023 due to private land dispute

cases.title: Wellington Mt Victoria summit toilets — removed 2024, mark says open

cases.title: Tongariro Crossing Mangatepopo carpark — shuttle-only since 2017, mark says drive
